name: volto-mask
draw: Full face white mask with smooth cheeks, a straight nose, closed lips and ribbon ties at the sides.

name: bauta-mask
draw: Full face mask with a jutting square chin, a prominent nose and no mouth opening, under a tricorn hat.

name: vejigante-mask
draw: Mask with many cone shaped horns sprouting all around the head and a wide toothy mouth.

name: krampus-mask
draw: Carved mask with long twisted goat horns, shaggy fur around the face and a long hanging tongue.

name: pierrot-face
draw: White round face with a black teardrop under one eye, a small skullcap and a ruffled collar below.

name: ogre-face
draw: Broad face with small ears, a heavy brow, a wide flat nose and two tusks rising from the lower lip.

name: shoulder-angel-devil
draw: Head and shoulders in front view with a tiny haloed angel on one shoulder and a tiny horned devil on the other.

name: thumbing-nose-face
draw: Face with a thumb pressed on the nose and fingers spread wide, tongue sticking out.

name: pulling-eyelid-face
draw: Face pulling down one lower eyelid with a fingertip while sticking out the tongue.

name: hand-on-heart-face
draw: Face with closed eyes and a soft smile, one hand pressed on the chest over a small heart.

name: eyes-in-the-dark
draw: Dark solid rounded shape with two glowing almond shaped eyes staring out of it.

name: kilroy-was-here
draw: Bald head with a long nose drooping over a wall edge, two eyes peeking and fingers gripping the wall.

name: face-without-mouth
draw: Round face with two dot eyes and no mouth at all.

name: distorted-face
draw: Face whose outline and features are warped into wavy lines, with mismatched eyes and a skewed mouth.

name: side-eye-face
draw: Face with both pupils shifted hard to one side, one raised brow and a flat mouth.

name: disgusted-face
draw: Face with a wrinkled nose, squinting eyes and the tongue pushed out of a downturned mouth.

name: weary-face
draw: Face with eyes squeezed shut in arcs, brows tilted up and a wide open wailing mouth.

name: proud-face
draw: Face tilted up with the chin raised, closed eyes, a satisfied smile and a small sparkle beside it.

name: facial-landmarks
draw: Face outline with small dots marking the eyes, brows, nose, mouth and jawline, joined by thin lines.

name: emotion-recognition
draw: Face inside four corner scan brackets with a small smile and a small frown icon beside it.

name: face-swap
draw: Two small round faces side by side with two curved swap arrows arcing between them.

name: moai-head
draw: Tall stone head from the front with a long nose, heavy brow ridge, long ears and a jutting chin.

name: olmec-head
draw: Colossal round stone head wearing a fitted helmet cap, with full lips and a broad flat nose.

name: stress-ball
draw: Round squishy ball with a simple face squeezed in a hand so it bulges out between the fingers.

name: hangover-face
draw: Face with droopy half closed eyes, a wavy mouth and an ice pack resting on top of the head.

name: brain-freeze-face
draw: Face grimacing with eyes squeezed shut, one hand on the forehead and an ice cream cone in the other.

name: bed-head-face
draw: Sleepy face with one eye half open, a yawning mouth and messy hair sticking up in tufts.

name: twitching-eye-face
draw: Face with a tense forced smile and one eye twitching, marked by short zigzag lines beside it.

name: mad-scientist-face
draw: Face with wild frizzy hair sticking out, goggles pushed up on the forehead and a manic grin.

name: punk-face
draw: Face with a tall spiked mohawk down the middle of the head, a safety pin earring and a sneer.
